title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 122 W. Goodwin Street, Pleasanton, Texas, as the "Pleasanton Veterans Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 122 W. Goodwin Street, Pleasanton, Texas, as the "Pleasanton Veterans Post Office."

summary.headline: A 2018 law renamed the Pleasanton, Texas post office the "Pleasanton Veterans Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Pleasanton, Texas, a new official name, the "Pleasanton Veterans Post Office." The building is located at 122 W. Goodwin Street. It is a symbolic honor and does not change how the post office runs or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018.
